# Dr.Bill

> Canadian medical billing software enabling physicians and healthcare teams to streamline claims submission and billing automation across provincial health plans.

Dr.Bill provides specialized medical billing solutions for Canadian physicians across Ontario (OHIP), British Columbia (MSP), and Alberta (AHCIP). The platform serves both solo practitioners and healthcare teams, with mobile app support and tools designed for medical office assistants and billing agents.

- Medical billing software
- Claims management

## Provincial Solutions

- [Ontario - Dr.Bill](https://www.dr-bill.ca/physicians/ontario): Dr.Bill OHIP billing solution for Ontario physicians
- [British Columbia - Dr.Bill](https://www.dr-bill.ca/physicians/british-columbia): Dr.Bill MSP billing solution for British Columbia physicians
- [Alberta - Dr.Bill](https://www.dr-bill.ca/physicians/alberta): Dr.Bill AHCIP billing solution for Alberta physicians

## Team & Clinic Solutions
